fusions.name: Anvil Drop
fusions.desc: Drops its full weight onto the target, dealing 40 damage and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Levelling Blow
fusions.desc: Sweeps the ground flat, dealing 20 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 3.5 tiles back.

fusions.name: Planted Stance
fusions.desc: Plants and braces, reducing the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Even Ground
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour. Your dodge chance rises by 6%.
